name: Underwater dungeon
description: Legends tell about a vast, labyrinthine dungeon in the north Central Sea. It is filled with luminescent flora and fauna and some breathable chambers. This is where remnants from battles against the Ungods rest, so very unique relics can be found there, especially the penumbral stone, a gem with powers that supposedly match the moonstone. The stories narrate a hero who had to open the doors by redirecting the water current there when activating a water device, passing through coral labyrinths, facing sea monstrosities, including giant piranhas, and traps where touching the wrong combination of stones causes the water to boil. In the tale, he discovers an ancient library and a mysterious box. The end of the story was lost in time, but people say this hero became a guardian of the place.
